sections.Profile:
The Stern Electronics "Dracula" pinball machine, released in January 1979, was designed by Harry Williams. It features a supernatural theme with notable gameplay elements such as three flippers, three pop bumpers, a passive bumper, and various targets including a spinning target and horseshoe lane. The game uses the same ROMs as Stern's "Wild Fyre" and was also produced in Australia under license by LAI.
